intro: I am Arsene Kahunga, a Founder and Software Developer passionate about building practical software solutions, exploring emerging technologies and transforming ideas into meaningful digital products.

Through M.A.R.J.E.N.E Software Development, I work on websites, mobile applications, desktop software and digital solutions designed to solve real-world problems. My interests span software engineering, application development, technology innovation, business systems and continuous learning.
I believe in building technology that makes a difference, creating opportunities through innovation and growing through every project.
